import bpy
roots = sorted(obj.name for obj in bpy.context.scene.objects if obj.type == 'EMPTY' and obj.name.startswith('location_'))
meshes = [obj for obj in bpy.context.scene.objects if obj.type == 'MESH']
result = {'location_roots': roots, 'location_count': len(roots), 'mesh_count': len(meshes), 'triangle_count': sum(len(obj.data.polygons) for obj in meshes), 'scene_camera': bpy.context.scene.camera.name if bpy.context.scene.camera else None}
